label: Live_servo_data
info:
SIE Servo Press → map live Modbus readings → POST PMS /api/machines/telemetry.

Raw integers are posted (do NOT pre-scale).
PMS applies catalog scales: position/velocity/Pressed Pos ×0.001, force/Pressed Force ×0.1, standby/pressing ×0.1, production ×0.01.

replaceReadings=true so each Edge snapshot replaces sticky simulator residue.
First successful map also sends resetLog=true once to clear old alarm/history rows.

Edit node 'cfg PMS URL + device' so DEVICE_NAME matches machines.name (or set MACHINE_ID / plc_topic).

name: cfg PMS URL + device
map live → PMS telemetry
mark resetLog done
force clear PMS log next post
allow resetLog again
